scope: Source-scoped evidence records for developmental USAG-1 tooth-germ activation; not an efficacy estimate

evidence_records.source_title: Murashima-Suginami et al. 2021: anti-USAG-1 tooth-development experiments
evidence_records.license: Primary source CC BY 4.0; attributed summary
evidence_records.developmental_interval: Embryonic mouse models and postnatal ferrets
evidence_records.model_system: Mouse congenital tooth-agenesis models and postnatal ferret; experimental antibodies #37/#57 are not TRG035
evidence_records.comparator: Source-defined genetic, antibody and untreated controls
evidence_records.outcome: Selected anti-USAG-1 antibodies rescued tooth agenesis in mice; #37 induced a third-dentition-like extra maxillary incisor in ferret
evidence_records.measure: Tooth phenotype, birth/survival, microCT and histology
evidence_records.value: The ferret result required fivefold higher concentration, three administrations and immunosuppression; the extra tooth appeared to have a short root. Antibodies #12/#16/#48 had low birth and survival rates in tested maternal mouse experiments; #57 produced extra/fused teeth and faint SOST cross-reactivity.
evidence_records.independent_unit: Animal/litter; tooth outcomes may be nested within animals
evidence_records.sample_size: Varies across antibody and model groups; counts are not pooled in this review
evidence_records.follow_up: Mouse offspring assessed at source-specific ages; ferret microCT at 13 weeks after birth
evidence_records.notes: Supports developmental activation in selected animal models, with adverse tooth-number, fusion and survival signals. It does not show a normal-rooted, load-bearing tooth replacement in humans. The experimental antibody series must remain separate from later humanized TRG035 claims.

evidence_records.source_title: jRCT2051240154: Phase I single-administration TRG035 study
evidence_records.license: Public registry record; summarized with attribution
evidence_records.stage_track: Phase I recruitment complete; no registry results posted
evidence_records.developmental_interval: Adult participants, one single-dose study period
evidence_records.model_system: Target 30 men aged 30-65 with at least one missing molar; randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled dose escalation
evidence_records.outcome: Primary outcome is safety; secondary outcomes are pharmacokinetics and frequency of serum anti-TRG035 antibody
evidence_records.measure: Registered trial design and outcomes; no tooth-formation endpoint listed
evidence_records.value: The official latest jRCT record lists recruitment status Complete; the record was last modified October 3, 2025. Target n=30; no trial results are posted.
evidence_records.follow_up: Single administration; no tooth-regeneration efficacy interval listed
evidence_records.notes: A prior retrieval through the legacy /pages/en-detail/87909/jRCT/3 route returned Pending; the canonical latest-record URL reports Complete. The registry primary outcome is safety, with pharmacokinetics and serum anti-TRG035 antibodies as secondary outcomes. Recruitment completion does not provide tooth-regeneration efficacy evidence.

evidence_records.source_title: Toregem 2026: Phase IIa trial-notification review completed
evidence_records.license: Company disclosure; status claim attributed to sponsor
evidence_records.stage_track: Phase IIa notification review complete; site IRB review followed by planned enrollment/dosing (last trial-specific sponsor update August 17, 2026)
evidence_records.comparator: No control group in the sponsor-announced design
evidence_records.outcome: Planned trial targets tooth formation in a congenital missing-tooth population
evidence_records.measure: Sponsor-reported trial design and regulatory status
evidence_records.value: PMDA review of the clinical-trial notification completed August 17, 2026; target sample size 24. The sponsor says enrollment and dosing are planned after institutional review.
evidence_records.follow_up: No outcome follow-up reported in the notice
evidence_records.notes: The August 17, 2026 notice says enrollment and dosing are planned after review by the trial-site IRB. No later trial-specific enrollment update was identified in the official sponsor news reviewed through October 10, 2026. This does not establish that enrollment remains pending, and it is not efficacy evidence. The study targets congenital agenesis, not adult acquired tooth loss.

evidence_records.source_title: Murashima-Suginami et al. 2026: imaging biomarkers for tooth-germ staging
evidence_records.license: Abstract indexed in Europe PMC; full text unavailable in this review
evidence_records.stage_track: Developmental imaging biomarker study; not a therapeutic efficacy study
evidence_records.model_system: MRI combined with CT/X-ray evaluation of developmental tooth structures
evidence_records.outcome: Dental lamina and pre-calcified tooth germ were visualized in the animal model
evidence_records.value: The authors propose imaging markers for identifying tooth-development stage; no human validation is reported in the abstract
evidence_records.independent_unit: Ferret pup; exact sample size was not available in the abstract reviewed
evidence_records.sample_size: Not stated in the abstract reviewed
evidence_records.notes: Imaging/staging evidence does not demonstrate that TRG035 causes tooth formation or validate a human surrogate endpoint. Indexed author affiliations include Toregem BioPharma.
